user.title: Select a Somfy IO radio bridge
user.description: Choose an ESPHome bridge running the GUI commissioning firmware.

error.bridge_unavailable: That bridge is no longer available.

abort.no_compatible_bridges: No compatible online ESPHome bridge was found. Flash the manager firmware first and wait for its entities to appear.

menu_options.move_shutter: Move a shutter to another slot
menu_options.resume_attempt: Resume or safely discard an unfinished attempt

add_shutter.title: New independently controlled shutter
add_shutter.description: Choose the initial firmware slot, shutter name, area, and calibration. For a Venetian blind, turn the wheel fully counterclockwise, count only the detents that move the slats to the clockwise endpoint, and enter the saved MY slat step measured from that counterclockwise endpoint. Do not count endpoint-check clicks. The slot can be changed later. A new controller identity and AES key are generated securely inside the ESP; they are never shown in the UI.

data.name: Shutter name
data.my_tilt_step: Saved MY tilt step from counterclockwise endpoint

capture_remote.title: Capture the shutter's existing remote
capture_remote.description: Slot {slot} is listening for 120 seconds. Briefly press OPEN or CLOSE once on the physical remote that already controls this shutter. Do not press PROG yet. Then tick the box and submit.

prepare_pairing.title: Put only this shutter into programming mode
prepare_pairing.description: On the captured physical remote ({remote}), select only **{name}**. Hold its recessed PROG button until that shutter performs one short jog. Do not continue if another shutter jogs. The next submit sends the new controller's pairing frame exactly once.

data.program_jogged: The intended shutter jogged after holding PROG

confirm_pairing.title: Confirm the pairing jog
confirm_pairing.description: Did **{name}** perform a second short jog immediately after the previous submit? If unsure, answer no. The controller identity will be preserved and the wizard will not blindly retransmit it.

data.pairing_jogged: Yes, the intended shutter performed the second jog

import_existing.title: Import an already-paired firmware slot
import_existing.description: Use this for a controller identity already imported by ESPHome YAML, such as the existing kitchen shutter. Choose its current slot and where you want it now; that destination can be changed later. Moving it preserves the same identity and rolling-code stream and transmits no RF. GUI slot numbers start at 1.

data.name: Shutter name
data.my_tilt_step: Saved MY tilt step from counterclockwise endpoint

resume_attempt.title: Unfinished commissioning attempt
resume_attempt.description: A staged identity may be discarded only before any pairing RF was sent. After a pairing transmission it is retained to avoid consuming another receiver slot or losing a possibly paired controller.

move_shutter.title: Move a shutter to another firmware slot
move_shutter.description: This changes only the ESP's internal organization. The controller identity, AES key, rolling-code stream, calibration, and motor pairing stay with the shutter. No RF is transmitted.

swap_shutters.title: Swap two shutter slots
swap_shutters.description: Choose two managed shutters to exchange their firmware slots. Both controller identities, rolling-code streams, calibrations, backups, and motor pairings stay with their shutters. No RF is transmitted and no empty slot is required.

calibration_values.title: Position calibration
calibration_values.description: Enter measured end-to-end movement times. MY is the approximate cover percentage used by Home Assistant's height model; the radio still recalls the motor's native favourite. For a Venetian blind, also enter the saved MY slat step counted clockwise from the counterclockwise endpoint.

data.my_tilt_step: Saved MY tilt step from counterclockwise endpoint

finish_setup.title: Finish shutter setup
finish_setup.description: The shutter identity is already safe in the ESP. Retry the final calibration and backup step; no pairing frame will be retransmitted.

error.invalid_my_tilt_step: The MY tilt step must be between zero and the full tilt detent count.
error.slot_entity_missing: The generated ESPHome cover for this slot has not appeared yet. Wait for the bridge to reconnect, then submit again.
error.manager_unavailable: The ESPHome commissioning manager did not respond. Check that the bridge is online and its custom actions are enabled.
error.press_remote_first: Press OPEN or CLOSE on the physical remote before continuing.
error.remote_not_detected: No matching remote press was captured. Listening has restarted for another 120 seconds.
error.program_jog_required: Confirm the first programming jog before a pairing frame can be sent.
error.slot_not_active: That firmware slot does not contain a confirmed active controller.
error.cannot_discard_after_pairing: This identity cannot be discarded because a pairing frame may already have reached the shutter.
error.attempt_not_resumable: The firmware slot is not in a resumable state.
error.target_slot_not_empty: The destination firmware slot is already occupied. Use Swap two shutter slots when both slots contain managed shutters.
error.both_slots_must_be_active: Both firmware slots must contain confirmed active shutters.

abort.no_managed_shutters: No shutters have been added to this bridge.
abort.not_enough_managed_shutters: At least two managed shutters are required for a slot swap.
